purpose: Canonical prompt library for transparent, single-garment PNG wardrobe assets. Generate each asset with 06_transparent_wardrobe_asset_api.json; then use 07_wardrobe_to_episode_api.json with the character identity reference and a scene reference.
global_asset_suffix: ONE standalone wardrobe garment asset only, no person. Front-on orthographic product-documentary view; complete garment fully visible with generous empty margin; symmetrical neutral lay-flat silhouette; isolated against one perfectly flat pure chroma-green #00FF00 background; no floor, shadow, gradient, prop, hanger, mannequin, rack, or background object. The green background is temporary and will be converted to transparency. Habitat Sol civilian workwear: repairable, practical, modest, realistic fabric weave, no readable text.
global_negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, fashion editorial, glamour photography, mannequin, person, face, hands, body, duplicate garment, clothing rack, hanger, floor, wall, studio set, readable text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, signature, badge, decal, insignia, patch, armor, military uniform, glossy generic sci-fi, plastic fabric, deformed garment, cropped garment
asset_review: The PNG has an actual transparent alpha background—not green fringe, shadow, or a solid background.
Exactly one complete garment is visible, including both sleeves/legs where relevant.
No generated text, logo, competing patch, badge, or label appears.
The garment is front-on and reads clearly at thumbnail size before it is used in a scene.
The selected prompt, seed, model, workflow filename, and output path are retained in the episode production record.
